name: Leopard Maara
original_name: レオパルド マーラ
source:
A student of the great monster girl tamer Bastal Batch his only experience with taming monster girls is from his studies. A [url=http://vndb.org/c10475]Captain Vanilla[/url] confuses him for his teacher, knocks him out, and drags him to Squid Paradise to help free the girls from their curse and rule by [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url].

He can tame monster girls by having them look into his eyes and repeating a contract spell. Once tamed a monster girl will be loyal to him forever.
